title: Stock market crash: Over 1,500 stocks hit 52-week lows as Sensex tanks 1,636 points | Stock Market News
summary: March 30, 2020, saw the Indian equity market hit hard due to escalating US-Iran tensions, rising oil prices, and concerns over India's macroeconomic stability, leading to a broad market sell-off across various segments and stocks hitting 52-week lows.
sentiment_reason: The market sentiment is strongly negative due to geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and a significant market sell-off, impacting investor confidence and leading to a sharp decline in stock indices.
